dominant_strengths: Clean 4x2 grid with consistent icon treatment provides predictable scanability and acceptable rhythm
Restrained monochrome palette avoids visual noise and keeps focus on iconography labels
Uniform circular icon containers create coherent visual system across categories
dominant_weaknesses: Brief promised 'warm' iteration but execution is cold near-grayscale with zero hue or warmth
Tiny low-contrast labels under 80% gray icons feel washed out and undermine readability hierarchy
Floating panel mid-canvas with massive empty black void above shows no spatial intent or anchoring
fix_priorities: Introduce actual warm palette—amber, terracotta, or warm-tinted neutrals—to fulfill the brief
Anchor the panel with proper vertical composition or fill negative space with context
Increase label contrast and consider weight pairing between heading and grid labels
rationale.norman_balance: Behavioral function is adequate but visceral warmth and reflective meaning are absent, contradicting the stated warm intent.
rationale.intent_fit: Fails the brief—'warm' is the explicit intent yet the output reads as a cold default dark-mode launcher with no warmth signals.
